meaningZh: 没有足够的食物、金钱和正常生活所需的东西

meaningZh: 出名

exampleZh: 从最近的抗议活动中对学生进行的调查显示，不健康的食物和很少的选择是投诉的主要原因，其次是高价格、不友好的服务和有限的开放时间。

meaningZh: U 煮熟的面粉、脂肪和水的混合物，通常用于覆盖或容纳其他食物
example: The most popular sweet dish is called "Apfelstrudel", which is a bit of potato pastry filled with apples and nuts.

meaningZh: U 为帮助一个国家或一群人而提供的金钱、食物或设备

meaningZh: 不是水平或垂直的角度，而是倾斜的

meaningZh: 一种粘稠的棕色水果，里面有一颗长种子

meaningZh: 不适合食用

meaningZh: U 将新设备投入使用的过程
example: Last but not least, students asked for the installation of a beverage machine - that would be really convenient for them.
exampleZh: 最后但并非最不重要的一点是，学生们要求安装一台饮料机——这对他们来说真的很方便。

meaningZh: 涉及或影响您所谈论的其他事物或人
example: Of course, the process of women's liberation isn't viewed with enthusiasm by husbands who would have to wash up and cook if their wives wanted to develop women interests beyond their family circle.
exampleZh: 当然，丈夫们并不热衷于看待妇女解放的过程，如果妻子想要在家庭圈子之外发展女性的兴趣，他们就必须洗碗做饭。

meaningZh: 晶莹剔透 极其清澈
example: You will be amazed by the crystal clear water of the shallow sea and the multitude of colourful fish which you will see as you are exploring the bottom of the sea.
exampleZh: 当您探索海底时，您会惊叹于浅海清澈见底的海水和众多色彩缤纷的鱼类。

meaningZh: 准备土地和种植农作物的过程
example: The basic thing is that people should be provided with better facilities for their cultivation of crops and farming, so they can earn their bread and butter in their own environment.
exampleZh: 最基本的是，应该为人们提供更好的农作物种植和农业设施，这样他们就可以在自己的环境中谋生。

meaningZh: 食用安全且无害
example: Part of your journey can be made through the forests where you can pick up some edible berries and wild mushrooms but be careful, you may need the local guide to help you with decisions there.

meaningZh: 一块厚的树干或树枝，尤指用于火烧的切块
example: People used to cook with fire logs but they don't do it any more.
exampleZh: 人们过去常常用柴火做饭，但现在已经不再这样做了。

meaningZh: 浓稠、辛辣的黄色或棕色酱汁，通常与肉一起少量食用

exampleZh: 这篇文章提出了一些有效的观点，例如定期发布的相互矛盾的研究是许多混乱的基础，我们应该吃我们想吃的东西，当然还有一点常识。

meaningZh: 动词 I 或 T（啜饮，啜饮）喝，一次只喝少量
example: The reasons for my choice are far from being profound: maybe it is only the desire of going back to a time when women ... could spend all the time brushing their hair or sipping tea, without feeling guilty for wasting their time.
exampleZh: 我做出选择的原因远非深刻：也许只是希望回到那个时代，那时女性……可以花所有的时间梳头或喝茶，而不用因为浪费时间而感到内疚。

meaningZh: 动词 I 或 T 如果液体浸湿某处或浸湿某物，则它会使某物变得非常湿。
example: The fish tank had been upended causing the fish to drop dead and the water had soaked the fitted carpet.
exampleZh: 鱼缸被翻倒了，导致鱼掉下来死了，水也浸湿了地毯。

meaningZh: 沿着/向下/穿过等漫步以缓慢而轻松的方式走到某处
example: Some of us were a bit upset because they wanted some free time to stroll around the shops or have a chat over a drink.
exampleZh: 我们中的一些人有点不安，因为他们想要一些空闲时间在商店里逛逛或者喝一杯聊天。

meaningZh: 帮助治愈疾病或改善您的健康
example: The drink produced, tsikondia, is one of the necessary drinks for the cold nights of winter. It is also believed to have therapeutic effects on people's health.
exampleZh: 生产的饮料“tsikondia”是寒冷冬夜必备的饮料之一。人们还认为它对人们的健康具有治疗作用。

meaningZh: 继续发生
example: I am not sure which is the best way to proceed with this problem. produce Word family: Nouns: producer, product, production, productivity, reproduction Verbs: produce, reproduce Adjectives: productive, unproductive VERB T /prəˈdjuːs/

meaningZh: 一块又长又窄的东西

exampleZh: 之后，工人们必须使用最基本的工具和双手，用丝条生产袜子。

meaningZh: C 危险的东西
example: Like all things, mobile phones have advantages and disadvantages. ... It is said that they produce cancer and that they are a health hazard.
exampleZh: 与所有事物一样，手机也有优点和缺点。 ...据说它们会产生癌症并且危害健康。

meaningZh: 提议或建议，通常在商业中
example: If you will consider this proposition positively, then we would like to produce a deal for you to become our only importer in Britain.
exampleZh: 如果您积极考虑这一提议，那么我们希望与您达成协议，成为我们在英国的唯一进口商。

meaningZh: C 或 U 展示如何做某事或某事如何工作
example: Some of our workers will give you a demonstration on how they produce, step by step, some of the world's best-known rings and necklaces.
exampleZh: 我们的一些工人将向您演示他们如何逐步生产一些世界上最著名的戒指和项链。

meaningZh: 写一篇文章或一个你打算稍后更改的计划
example: I hope all these statements will help you to draft the new programme, good luck!
exampleZh: 我希望所有这些陈述对您起草新方案有所帮助，祝您好运！

meaningZh: 某人的旅行某人的旅程
example: In these travels I learnt a lot because we had to deal with very different people.
exampleZh: 在这些旅行中我学到了很多东西，因为我们必须与非常不同的人打交道。

meaningZh: 食用安全且无害
example: Part of your journey can be made through the forests where you can pick up some edible berries and wild mushrooms but be careful, you may need the local guide to help you with decisions there.
exampleZh: 您的部分旅程可以穿过森林，在那里您可以采摘一些可食用的浆果和野生蘑菇，但要小心，您可能需要当地向导来帮助您做出决定。

meaningZh: 非常震惊和不安
example: To begin with, everyone was devastated at how long we had to wait at the airport, as the flight to Dublin was late.
exampleZh: 首先，由于飞往都柏林的航班晚点，每个人都对我们在机场等待的时间感到震惊。

meaningZh: 出于特定原因、目的等
example: I specifically chose to travel with you since your travel brochure promised a half-day trip to St. Andrews, where I was to meet my friend Ann.
exampleZh: 我特意选择和你们一起旅行，因为你们的旅行手册承诺去圣安德鲁斯半日游，在那里我会见我的朋友安。

meaningZh: 飞机、轮船、公共汽车或火车上
example: Competition entry "Welcome aboard on the flight to ancient Rome..." Please fasten your seatbelts...
exampleZh: 竞赛参赛作品“欢迎搭乘飞往古罗马的航班……”请系好安全带……

meaningZh: 酒店、剧院、机场等地方人们可以放松或等待的房间

exampleZh: 中央休息室设有自动巴士售票机。

meaningZh: 动词 I（跌倒，跌倒）失败 如果一个事件或笑话失败，则它无法达到您想要的效果，例如让人们发笑。
example: The cultural visits fell flat in comparison to their expectations, although the sightseeing tour of Willstown was, as the students said, "fascinating".
exampleZh: 尽管威尔斯敦的观光之旅正如学生们所说“令人着迷”，但与他们的预期相比，文化访问却表现平平。

meaningZh: 副词（更平淡，最平淡） 失败 如果一个事件或笑话失败了，它就没有达到你想要的效果，比如让人发笑。
example: The cultural visits fell flat in comparison to their expectations, although the sightseeing tour of Willstown was, as the students said, "fascinating".
exampleZh: 尽管威尔斯敦的观光之旅正如学生们所说“令人着迷”，但与他们的预期相比，文化访问却表现平平。

meaningZh: 在分隔两个人、地点或事物的空间中
example: There is a shuttle bus from the airport straight to the main station with only one stop in between.
exampleZh: 有班车从机场直达火车总站，中间仅一站。

meaningZh: 跨水旅行
example: On the ferry there are restaurants and a Tax-Free Shop. The crossing takes about 50 minutes.
exampleZh: 渡轮上设有餐厅和免税店。过境大约需要 50 分钟。

meaningZh: 名词 C 或 U 前往某个地方了解某事的旅程
example: In the near future robots will take part in space exploration, as well as ocean exploration.
exampleZh: 在不久的将来，机器人将参与太空探索以及海洋探索。

meaningZh: 以粗鲁的方式
example: When I made an attempt to speak to the conductor, I was rudely told off and told to stay seated for the rest of the journey.
exampleZh: 当我试图与售票员交谈时，我被粗鲁地叫停，并被告知在剩下的旅程中保持坐在座位上。

meaningZh: 您计划在旅途中参观的地点列表
example: Finally, although the itinerary involved a visit to St. Andrews, for some unknown reasons we never went there and I was really disappointed.
exampleZh: 最后，虽然行程中涉及参观圣安德鲁斯，但由于某些未知的原因我们从未去过那里，我真的很失望。

meaningZh: 就像疯狂的非正式做很多或快速的事情
example: My heart was beating like crazy and when the ski-boat started its journey along the blue waves of the sea...
exampleZh: 当滑雪船沿着碧波荡漾的大海开始航行时，我的心疯狂地跳动……

meaningZh: 您通过步行完成的漫长而艰难的旅程
example: SPECIAL ACTIVITIES include a trek through a dense forest and then climbing a hill which is a unique experience for everyone. For the bolder there is something more extreme.
exampleZh: 特别活动包括徒步穿越茂密的森林，然后爬上一座小山，这对每个人来说都是一次独特的体验。对于更大胆的人来说，还有更极端的事情。

meaningZh: 就像疯狂的非正式做很多或快速的事情
example: My heart was beating like crazy and when the ski-boat started its journey along the blue waves of the sea...
exampleZh: 当滑雪船沿着碧波荡漾的大海开始航行时，我的心疯狂地跳动……

meaningZh: 数量很少
example: Bigger car parks would be built near the MRT station so that people may park their cars at the car park having to pay a minimal rate and use the train to bring them to their workplace.
exampleZh: 捷运站附近将建造更大的停车场，以便人们可以将汽车停放在停车场，只需支付最低费用，然后乘坐火车将其带到工作场所。

meaningZh: 定期往返于工作地点和家之间
example: People who work in the centre will have to commute from the suburbs which will be a waste of time for them.
exampleZh: 在市中心工作的人们将不得不从郊区通勤，这对他们来说是浪费时间。

meaningZh: U 当某人因处于特定情况或地点而经历某事或受其影响时
example: Due to exposure to low temperatures throughout the tour I developed pneumonia and had to be admitted to hospital on arrival in London.
exampleZh: 由于整个旅行期间都暴露在低温下，我患上了肺炎，抵达伦敦后不得不住进医院。

meaningZh: 价格低、质量好
example: The "luxury hotel" from the advertisement happened to be a dirty, cheap hotel with no lift (notice that all the rooms were located on the 4th floor) and no service.
exampleZh: 广告上的“豪华酒店”恰好是一家又脏又便宜的酒店，没有电梯（注意所有房间都位于四楼），也没有服务。

meaningZh: C 一个不真实但被很多人相信的想法
example: There is this myth that when you are on holiday you should spend your whole time at the beach, practically doing nothing.
exampleZh: 有一种误解认为，当您度假时，您应该把所有时间都花在海滩上，几乎什么也不做。

meaningZh: 想要某物
example: Indeed, the location of this hotel will allow all of us to do whatever we desire.
exampleZh: 事实上，这家酒店的位置可以让我们所有人做任何我们想做的事。

meaningZh: 被恼怒的感觉
example: This caused a lot of annoyance, so I suggest next year you make some kind of arrangement for booking the places on the computer room in advance.
exampleZh: 这造成了很多麻烦，所以我建议明年你提前做好一些安排，提前预订机房的位置。

meaningZh: 我在聚会或类似活动中与很多人见面并交谈
example: If you have some time and money to spend go on holiday to an English-speaking country and try to mingle with the locals.
exampleZh: 如果您有时间和金钱，可以去英语国家度假并尝试与当地人打交道。

meaningZh: 着陆/着陆等。如果一个物体或人着陆在某个地方，他们就会掉到那里的地面上。
example: Then, when your booking form landed on my door mat, I decided to take matters into my own hands and to pay a visit to this conference.
exampleZh: 然后，当您的预订表落在我的门垫上时，我决定亲自处理此事并参加这次会议。

meaningZh: 某物的复制品，尤其是一幅画
example: It would be great if the park provided some flight simulators and a reproduction of a space shuttle (so that people get a feeling of how it is to be an astronaut).
exampleZh: 如果公园能提供一些飞行模拟器和航天飞机的复制品就太好了（让人们感受一下当宇航员是怎样的感觉）。

meaningZh: 以一种让你感到惊讶的方式
example: As for your flight attendants, who are always friendly and remarkably helpful, it would be excellent if they were able to speak other languages apart from English.
exampleZh: 至于您的空乘人员，他们总是很友好并且非常乐于助人，如果他们能够说英语以外的其他语言，那就太好了。

meaningZh: 对某事感到极度不喜欢或不赞成
example: As you realise, I am thoroughly disgusted with the tour which you provided.
exampleZh: 正如您所知，我对您提供的旅行感到非常厌恶。

meaningZh: 非常舒适而且昂贵
example: As far as the hotel is concerned, I feel that it wasn't a luxurious one.
exampleZh: 就酒店而言，我觉得不是一个豪华的酒店。

meaningZh: 最后或最重要的
example: The ultimate aim when I joined your tour was to meet one of my friends in St Andrews.
exampleZh: 我参加你们旅行的最终目的是去见见我在圣安德鲁斯的一位朋友。

meaningZh: 动词 (-tt-) I 或 T 与某物相同或类似
example: The accommodation I had during the trip didn't fit the description in the advertisement and neither did the restaurants or the cultural activities.
exampleZh: 我在旅途中的住宿与广告中的描述不符，餐厅和文化活动也不符合。

meaningZh: 很多
example: We had to spend countless hours in the cold coach waiting for a bus that could take us to the hotel in Edinburgh.
exampleZh: 我们不得不在寒冷的长途汽车中度过无数个小时，等待可以带我们前往爱丁堡酒店的巴士。

meaningZh: 当你正在做或正在做的事情完成时
example: After the completion of the work at the newly-built part of the airport and its opening for service, the formerly quiet part of the town has become a victim of the above mentioned kind of noise, even more than the parts which have had this problem for a long time.
exampleZh: 机场新建部分竣工并投入使用后，原本安静的小镇变成了上述噪音的受害者，甚至比长期存在这种问题的地方还要严重。

meaningZh: 关注某特定主题
example: This report is concerned with finding the best accommodation for the three-day trip in north- west England.
exampleZh: 本报告涉及寻找英格兰西北部三天旅行的最佳住宿。

meaningZh: C 对你有用或帮助你成功的人、技能或品质
example: I am sure that you will be more than satisfied with him and that he is going to be an asset to your hotel.
exampleZh: 我相信您会对他非常满意，并且他将成为您酒店的资产。

meaningZh: 一座你很容易认出的建筑，尤其是能帮助你知道自己在哪里的建筑
example: What they enjoyed most was the bus tour of London, on Tuesday, as it was a chance for them to see all the famous landmarks without walking.
exampleZh: 他们最喜欢的是周二的伦敦巴士之旅，因为这是他们无需步行即可游览所有著名地标的机会。

meaningZh: 使现有的观点、感觉或想法更加强烈
example: The first unfavourable impression was reinforced the moment we arrived at the hotel.
exampleZh: 当我们到达酒店的那一刻，第一印象就更加强烈了。

meaningZh: 以某物的形式出现或存在的特定方式
example: For all this, I can only say that I want my money back immediately, or some compensation in the form of a real trip to a real country.
exampleZh: 对于这一切，我只能说我希望立即拿回我的钱，或者以去一个真实国家的真实旅行的形式得到一些补偿。

meaningZh: 不够

meaningZh: 普通，或者无趣

meaningZh: 吸引某人的注意力/想象力/兴趣，使某人对某事感兴趣或兴奋

meaningZh: 工作是监督某人或某事的人

meaningZh: 正式地做某事以便你可以做某事

meaningZh: 与医疗和检查有关

meaningZh: 在其他事情之前存在或发生

meaningZh: 动词 (-pp-) T（也叫 drop off）带某人或某物去某个地方，通常是在您前往其他地方时开车

meaningZh: 以权威人士同意或安排的方式正式进行

meaningZh: 副词（也无论什么）不...无论如何，根本没有

meaningZh: 以与历史相关的方式

meaningZh: 比群体中所有其他人都更好的某人或某物

meaningZh: 拯救某人做某事以帮助某人避免不得不做某事

meaningZh: C 国王或王后统治一个国家的时期

meaningZh: C 或 U 液体或气体压在某个区域时产生的力

meaningZh: 名词 C 或 U 正式建议某人从事某项工作或通过其工作获得奖项的行为
example: Please allow me to support this nomination by pointing out some facts.
exampleZh: 请允许我指出一些事实来支持这一提名。

meaningZh: 在组织中担任第二重要工作的人
example: If you would like to have a teacher on your side, for general questions, I would propose our deputy principal Mr Brown.
exampleZh: 如果您希望有一位老师在您身边，对于一般性问题，我会推荐我们的副校长布朗先生。

meaningZh: 与决策和管理业务有关
example: So I am now an executive director, I have a job and I know very important people in the Romanian Government.

meaningZh: 当某人进行简短表演以尝试获得演员、歌手等工作时

exampleZh: 许多没有才华的人认为自己可以唱歌并参加海选，但其他人却嘲笑他们。

meaningZh: 完成特定工作的设备的一部分
example: Most chairs' adjusting mechanism failed to work properly and they are not comfortable to sit on.

meaningZh: C 职位或工作
example: I'm writing in my capacity as secretary of the Social Club of the language school to complain about the services provided to us during our visit to the Science and Technology museum.
exampleZh: 我以语言学校社交俱乐部秘书的身份写信，抱怨我们参观科技博物馆期间所提供的服务。

meaningZh: 工作是监督某人或某事的人
example: I held the post of general supervisor in a campus in Oxford two years ago, and now I am working as a receptionist in a luxurious hotel.
exampleZh: 两年前，我在牛津的一个校区担任总督，现在在一家豪华酒店担任接待员。

meaningZh: T 给某人一份工作或职位
example: Suppose if ten people retire from an organization, the vacancies are filled by bringing up the middle management and their previous positions will be filled be lower management.
exampleZh: 假设如果有十个人从一个组织退休，空缺将由中层管理人员填补，而他们以前的职位将由低层管理人员填补。

meaningZh: 尽你所能做某事 做你能够做并且被允许做的一切以实现某事
example: I think of myself as an open-minded and cheerful person and if I get the job I will do everything in my power to make sure your visitors will have a great time at the theme park.
exampleZh: 我认为自己是一个思想开放、开朗的人，如果我得到这份工作，我将尽我所能，确保您的游客在主题公园度过愉快的时光。

meaningZh: 名词 C（也是顾问）其工作是就某个主题提供建议的人
example: Some of our financial advisers could provide your students with the latest methods used in Accounting and in developing new business projects.
exampleZh: 我们的一些财务顾问可以为您的学生提供会计和开发新业务项目中使用的最新方法。

meaningZh: 总是在名词之前 正规教育、培训等是通过学习而不是在工作中进行的。
example: I never had any formal training in computers but I know how to operate the system, to make files and to use the internet.
exampleZh: 我从未接受过任何正式的计算机培训，但我知道如何操作系统、创建文件和使用互联网。

meaningZh: 工作是创造新产品的人，尤其是软件等计算机产品
example: For example, we may have the top website developers in China, but quite often their skills are restricted by poor IT infrastructures.
exampleZh: 例如，我们可能拥有中国顶尖的网站开发人员，但他们的技能往往受到糟糕的 IT 基础设施的限制。

meaningZh: 以与技术相关或涉及技术的方式
example: The economy nowadays is so technologically driven it is a common belief that having a job in the computer industry means high pay and perks.
exampleZh: 当今的经济是如此受技术驱动，人们普遍认为在计算机行业工作意味着高薪和福利。

meaningZh: 完成特定工作的小型设备，尤其是新型设备
example: I believe that robots and hi-tech gadgets will definitely invade our private and professional life.
exampleZh: 我相信机器人和高科技产品一定会侵入我们的私人和职业生活。

meaningZh: 工作涉及科学或电气设备的实际工作的人
example: It could be the fault of the sound technician, although I believe that for the next Activity day we should be provided with better equipment and loudspeakers.
exampleZh: 这可能是音响技术人员的错，尽管我相信在下一个活动日我们应该提供更好的设备和扬声器。

meaningZh: U 特定类型的单词，尤其是特定工作或学术领域的人使用的单词
example: English has become the language of science, so it seems, even though some of the papers, studies and publications are hard to read and understand.
exampleZh: 英语似乎已经成为科学语言，尽管一些论文、研究和出版物难以阅读和理解。

meaningZh: 会见和联系可能对你有用的人的活动，尤其是对你的工作
example: I am sure there are many other benefits working can bring to us, apart from the enjoyment, networking, etc. that I have mentioned above, and of course the money it makes.
exampleZh: 我相信，除了我上面提到的享受、人际网络等，当然还有它赚的钱之外，工作还可以给我们带来很多其他的好处。

meaningZh: 工厂、办公楼等现场
example: A small period of training on site is required a few days before the beginning of the job itself and how many interesting people you will meet!
exampleZh: 在工作开始前几天需要进行一小段时间的现场培训，您将遇到多少有趣的人！

meaningZh: 以令人满意的方式
example: The main problem is finding the most accurate meaning of some words, phrasal verbs, idioms etc. Dictionaries can do the job satisfactorily but the problem inside is left unsolved.
exampleZh: 主要问题是找到一些单词、短语动词、习语等最准确的含义。字典可以令人满意地完成这项工作，但内部问题尚未解决。

meaningZh: 正在学习如何做某事，尤其是工作的人
example: I work as a trainee at a big international trader company at Brazil, and there we had some problems of motivation in the workplace, and to resolve the problem we made a lot of changes and arrangements in our company.
exampleZh: 我在巴西一家大型国际贸易公司担任实习生，我们在工作场所遇到了一些激励问题，为了解决这个问题，我们在公司做了很多改变和安排。

meaningZh: 没有表现出从事熟练工作的人所期望的行为或技能标准
example: Your reporter was so inattentive and unprofessional that he did not bother to check the figures and mixed up 35 and 45.
exampleZh: 你们的记者太不专心、太不专业，连数字都懒得去核对，把35和45搞混了。

meaningZh: 一种电子舞曲
example: As for the music, Red Hot Chilli Peppers did a really fine job with "Otherside", while the other video has the classic techno beat.
exampleZh: 至于音乐，Red Hot Chilli Peppers 的《Otherside》做得非常好，而另一个视频则采用了经典的 techno 节拍。

meaningZh: 在人、物体、组织、地点或国家内部
example: I am actually very interested in taking the course, because recently I have changed my job and one of my functions is to create a page on the intranet to share information about the company internally.
exampleZh: 我其实对参加这门课程很感兴趣，因为最近我换了工作，我的职责之一就是在内网上创建一个页面，在内部分享公司的信息。

meaningZh: U 在组织中担任重要职务
example: The former Polish prime minister was a woman - Hanna Suchocka - and she was able to remain in office for 15 months, in the time when the life expectancy of governments in Poland is about half a year.
exampleZh: 波兰前总理是一位女性——汉娜·苏乔卡(Hanna Suchocka)，她能够连任15个月，而当时波兰政府的预期寿命只有半年左右。

meaningZh: 具有男性特有的品质
example: Life, nowadays is so hard for women: they have to cope with so many things every day, from their children to their job, not to mention housework, and the result of that is that women are more and more stressed, "masculine" I dare to say, and less and less "feminine".
exampleZh: 现在的生活对女人来说太辛苦了，每天要面对的事情太多了，从孩子到工作，更不用说做家务了，结果就是女人的压力越来越大，敢说“男性化”，而“女性化”越来越少。

meaningZh: 当某件事不太可能失败或丢失时
example: They are the people who are already regarded as high class, but the reason for this prediction is that they have job security which has become a big issue in Korea after IMF, as well as a high salary. see /siː/ (seeing, saw, seen)
exampleZh: 他们是已经被认为是上层阶级的人，但之所以做出这样的预测，是因为他们拥有继IMF之后成为韩国大问题的工作保障，以及高薪。 see /siː/（看见、看见、看见）

meaningZh: 您与保险公司签订的协议
example: Working in an insurance company often means 'selling the air', but when you see that a person gets out of a difficult situation just because he or she has an insurance policy, you begin to love this job.
exampleZh: 在保险公司工作往往意味着“卖空气”，但当你看到一个人仅仅因为有一份保险就摆脱了困境时，你就开始热爱这份工作。

meaningZh: 工作是治疗特定类型的精神或身体疾病的人
example: Teams for athletes or swimmers are built of: coach, physiologist, diet therapist, physiotherapist, doctor and massage therapist.
exampleZh: 运动员或游泳队的成员包括：教练、生理学家、饮食治疗师、物理治疗师、医生和按摩治疗师。

meaningZh: C 从事特定工作或具有类似兴趣的人员参加的大型正式会议，或政党的大型会议
example: Conference facilities: Being completely renovated, the historic building of Edessa's Cultural Association is the ideal place for a modern scientific convention.
exampleZh: 会议设施：埃德萨文化协会的历史建筑经过全面翻修，是举办现代科学会议的理想场所。

meaningZh: 名词 C 或 U 组织中的职位，例如军队，显示某人的重要性
example: Women were denied a higher rank and their job was limited to mundane tasks. VERB I or T to have a position in a list which shows things or people in order of importance, or to give someone or something a position on such a list

meaningZh: 远离……短语动词，以避免卷入对你产生不良影响的事情

meaningZh: 控制一个团体、国家或局势的工作

exampleZh: 除了他富有魅力的领导才能和开拓精神之外，埃莱夫塞里奥斯·韦尼泽洛斯与当时贫困和深感失望的人们非常亲近。领导力 控制一个团体、国家或局势的人

meaningZh: 正式推荐某人在组织中担任某项工作或职位，或者推荐某人或其工作以获得奖项
example: Being an Ambassador for Youth bears a lot of responsibility, not only because the person must be of outstanding character and well-known, but also because they must behave accordingly and be able to convey a positive message. After deep consideration, I have decided to nominate Jovanotti, alias Lorenzo Cherubini.
exampleZh: 作为青年大使肩负着很大的责任，不仅因为这个人必须品格优秀、知名度高，而且还因为他必须表现得相应，能够传达积极的信息。经过深思熟虑，我决定提名乔瓦诺蒂（Jovanotti），又名洛伦佐·凯鲁比尼（Lorenzo Cherubini）。

meaningZh: 试图说服某人为公司工作或加入组织
example: Secondly, the coach driver was quite a rude person and, as far as I am concerned, it would be a good idea to pay more attention when recruiting your staff.
exampleZh: 其次，长途汽车司机是一个非常粗鲁的人，就我而言，在招聘员工时多加注意是个好主意。

meaningZh: 有战争经验和技巧的人，特别是在过去的战争中
example: It is true that the Vikings were warriors, some would say bloodthirsty as well, but that is something I will leave to you to judge.
exampleZh: 确实，维京人是战士，有人会说他们也是嗜血的，但这是我将留给你来判断的事情。

meaningZh: 是一个问题，用于说明某种情况下最重要的问题是什么
example: The choice is a question of price.
exampleZh: 选择是一个价格问题。

meaningZh: 寻找人员为公司工作或成为组织新成员的过程
example: This is mainly due to the recent recruitment of office personnel in our department.
exampleZh: 这主要是由于我部门近期招聘办公室人员所致。

meaningZh: 名词 C 或 U 限制人们可以做的事情或情况
example: When people travel on their own, they can do what they want, without restrictions or limitations from their family. resume /rɪˈzjuːm/ FORMAL VERB I or T If an activity resumes, or if you resume it, it starts again after a pause.

meaningZh: 与某事的组织和管理有关
example: The engineers and administrative staff must be able to work in both English and French whereas German would be an asset.
exampleZh: 工程师和管理人员必须能够用英语和法语工作，而德语将是一种优势。

meaningZh: 使用或能够讲两种语言
example: The staff also seem reluctant to help travellers with their children and it would help if the staff were bilingual.
exampleZh: 工作人员似乎也不愿意帮助带孩子的旅客，如果工作人员会说双语就会有所帮助。

meaningZh: clean (sth/sb) up 短语动词使一个人或一个地方干净整洁
example: During our accommodation there, nobody came to clean up the room and the staff was not very friendly.
exampleZh: 在我们住宿期间，没有人来打扫房间，工作人员也不是很友好。

meaningZh: 当两个或更多人协作时，他们共同创造或实现同一件事。
example: Even if the staff they collaborated with were quite friendly and cheerful, all of them would prefer the jobs related with computers and new technology.
exampleZh: 即使合作的员工非常友好、开朗，但他们都更喜欢与计算机和新技术相关的工作。

meaningZh: C 一些让你抱怨的事情
example: My only complaint about the teaching staff is that they did not allow enough time for individual tuition and help when needed.
exampleZh: 我对教学人员的唯一抱怨是他们没有足够的时间进行个人辅导和需要时的帮助。

meaningZh: 对你有利的协议、安排或情况
example: The possibility of getting the needed staff from our own departments is absolutely a good deal for the company.
exampleZh: 从我们自己的部门获得所需员工的可能性对公司来说绝对是一笔划算的交易。

meaningZh: 提出问题（与某人/某事）不同意某人所说或所写的内容
example: On behalf of the staff who worked for this event, I would like to take issue with the report's inaccuracies and unfair remarks.
exampleZh: 我谨代表本次活动的工作人员，对报道中的不准确和不公正言论提出质疑。

meaningZh: 知道很多
example: The teaching staff are largely responsible for the quality of the classes, as they're very knowledgeable and patient; being able to find them after classes, though, was impossible.
exampleZh: 教学人员对课程质量负有主要责任，因为他们知识渊博且很有耐心；然而，下课后想要找到他们是不可能的。

meaningZh: 你可能喜欢/想要... 用于礼貌地建议某事
example: You might want to consider requesting your staff to learn a second language such as German, French or Spanish. might as well do sth If you may/might as well do something, it will not spoil the situation if you do that thing.

meaningZh: 某人（尤其是公司或组织）拥有的土地和建筑物
example: The staff will have more space to work in as our local branch is moving to larger premises, and better work conditions will be provided to them. present Word family: Nouns: presence, present Verbs: present Adjectives: present Adverbs: presently VERB T /prɪˈzent/ present a danger/difficulty/problem, etc. to cause a danger/difficulty/problem, etc.

meaningZh: 生产商品或完成工作的速率
example: Though time-consuming, these staff would need to undergo re-training to be able to achieve the highest level of productivity, besides getting accustomed to the nick-nacks of the Production Department.
exampleZh: 尽管耗时，但这些员工除了要适应生产部门的小细节之外，还需要接受再培训才能达到最高水平的生产力。

meaningZh: 因为无聊或紧张而无法保持安静或放松
example: The children that travel become very restless when they cannot see any movies or are not offered any games or any other entertainment from the staff.
exampleZh: 当旅行中的孩子们看不到任何电影或者工作人员没有为他们提供任何游戏或任何其他娱乐活动时，他们会变得非常焦躁。

meaningZh: 与另一个人或事物竞争的某人或某物
example: Around 60% of our international rivals had their stands there, usually with 2-3 staff members always kept busy by the public.
exampleZh: 我们大约 60% 的国际竞争对手都在那里设有展位，通常有 2-3 名工作人员一直在公众面前忙碌。

meaningZh: 粗鲁的品质
example: Many complaints were made about the rudeness of the reception staff.
exampleZh: 许多人抱怨接待人员的粗鲁行为。

meaningZh: 骨干人员/员工/服务 维持组织运转所需的最少人员数量
example: The life-rescuing services are on call and a skeleton staff remains in all hospitals.
exampleZh: 救生服务随时待命，所有医院都留有骨干人员。

meaningZh: 在区域、团体或系统内
example: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to you, as requested, in order to ensure that the training - whose purpose is to help the staff improve its communications with the other departments within the company - is effective and not just a waste of time.
exampleZh: 尊敬的先生或女士，我应要求写信给您，是为了确保培训（其目的是帮助员工改善与公司其他部门的沟通）有效，而不仅仅是浪费时间。

meaningZh: 让你能够长时间做某事的体力或精神能量
example: She is a healthy strong girl with stamina.
exampleZh: 她是一个身体健康、精力充沛、坚强的女孩。

meaningZh: 当每个人都同意彼此或想呆在一起时
example: I would conclude by saying that some healthy competition is good, but your main goal has to be to work together as a group and work towards the achievement of goals - as the saying goes, "united we stand, divided we fall" and unity is strength.
exampleZh: 最后我想说，一些良性的竞争是好的，但你的主要目标必须是作为一个团队共同努力，努力实现目标——俗话说，“团结则存，分裂则亡”，团结就是力量。

meaningZh: 香烟内的干叶子

meaningZh: 不重要或强大

exampleZh: 名人声称团队精神和竞争意识已经消失，事实证明，与其他娱乐活动相比，锻炼的重要性较低。

meaningZh: 工作是治疗特定类型的精神或身体疾病的人
example: Teams for athletes or swimmers are built of: coach, physiologist, diet therapist, physiotherapist, doctor and massage therapist.

meaningZh: 您吃的食物及其影响您健康的方式
example: So, good exercise combined with the right nutrition (low fat, vegetables etc.) will alter our lives and help us feel and appear more relaxed.
exampleZh: 因此，良好的锻炼与正确的营养（低脂肪、蔬菜等）相结合将改变我们的生活，帮助我们感觉和显得更加放松。

meaningZh: 极度肥胖

exampleZh: 体力活动减少和不良饮食可能导致超重甚至肥胖。

meaningZh: 能够让你相信某件事是真实的或正确的

meaningZh: 仅或不与其他人共享

meaningZh: 动词 I 或 T 变得更少，或者使某物变得更少

meaningZh: 名词 C 或 U 触摸某物时的感觉

meaningZh: 艺术科目，例如历史、语言和哲学，不是科学科目

meaningZh: 名词 C 或 U 当某人拒绝做或接受某事时

meaningZh: 非正式使用的名字，而不是您的真实姓名

meaningZh: 有趣，或者让你发笑

meaningZh: 一种大型、坚固的军用车辆，上面装有枪，通过大型金属带内的轮子移动

meaningZh: 由于某个特定原因

meaningZh: 读写能力

meaningZh: 拒绝考虑某个想法或意见

meaningZh: 非正式 非常愚蠢或愚蠢

meaningZh: 解决或结束问题或困难

meaningZh: 动词（withdrawn，撤回）T 从银行账户中取出钱

meaningZh: 在某物被损坏或毁坏后再次建造

meaningZh: 名词 C 或 U 对某事的热情，当你非常喜欢某事时

meaningZh: 用于指代特定的人或事物，而不具体说明是哪一个

meaningZh: 成为委员会/小组等团体或组织的成员

meaningZh: 名词 C 或 U（也是英国概括）当某人说一些非常基本的事情时，通常是正确的，但并不总是正确的

meaningZh: 数量、价值、重要性或意义相同

meaningZh: C 或 U 根据肤色等身体特征将人们分为的组之一

meaningZh: 吸引某人的注意力/想象力/兴趣，使某人对某事感兴趣或兴奋

meaningZh: 你必须处理或担心的困难或不愉快的事情

meaningZh: U 控制或指令

meaningZh: 倾向于思考/相信/同意等发表意见，但不是强烈的意见

meaningZh: 某人或某事受到公众关注的程度

meaningZh: 你特别重视某件事

meaningZh: VERB（设置，设置，设置）决定某事物的水平

meaningZh: 不直接由某事引起或与某事相关

meaningZh: 远离……短语动词，以避免卷入对你产生不良影响的事情
